vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the LDAP synchronization connection check that allows an authenticated API user to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Project MONAI MONAI Label Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Project MONAI MONAI Label contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to write arbitrary files outside the intended datastore directory, potentially resulting in remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Expressway Series Use of Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Cisco Expressway Series contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker with persistent cookies and network access to execute commands as root on a clustered device via the database service.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Roller Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache Roller contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint, which accepts and deserializes vendor extension types before authentication. This CVE covers the same underlying vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384 but applies to a broader range of affected versions.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: VMWare vCenter Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) Code Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server. An attacker could exploit this via crafted HTTP requests that access an unintended controller route from a public survey context and supply a crafted file-path or stream parameter during data import processing. Exploitation requires knowledge of a valid public survey hash.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Axis Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache Axis contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted SOAP fault message that causes Axis to load and instantiate an attacker-specified class when a suitable class is available on the application classpath. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: BerriAI LiteLLM Unprotected Alternate Channel Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: BerriAI LiteLLM contains an unprotected alternate channel vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code URI.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Synology DSM contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the system plugin daemon in Synology BeeStation OS (BSM) that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Perforce Puppet Enterprise Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Perforce Puppet Enterprise contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Puppet’s report-processing code that allows a client with any CA-signed agent certificate to execute arbitrary code on the Puppet Server as the service user by submitting a report containing a crafted rich-data type through a PUT request. If the certificate authority automatically signs requests without strong verification, an unauthenticated network attacker can obtain a valid certificate and exploit the vulnerability.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Multiple Products Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Check Point Firewall, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Scalable Platforms, Security Gateway, and Security Management Server contain an incorrect permissions assignment for critical resources vulnerability when the Gaia OS DynamicCLI daemon runs as root and listens on a world-writable local socket without authenticating connecting processes. An authenticated local user can send a command to the socket and have it executed as root.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: UnrealIRCd Improper Neutralization of Delimiters Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: UnrealIRCd UnrealIRCd contains an improper neutralization of delimiters vulnerability that allows any user on a network with two or more linked servers to inject server-to-server commands that are executed with server authority.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco BroadWorks Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Cisco BroadWorks contains an improper restriction of XML external entity reference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read sensitive configuration information on an affected system.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium Use-After-Free Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Google Chromium contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XML component that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a specially crafted webpage. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Outlook Missing User Interaction for Potentially Unsafe Action Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Office Outlook contains a missing user interaction for potentially unsafe action vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s global configuration. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-111560.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder Incorrect Resource Transfer Between Spheres Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder contains an incorrect resource transfer between spheres vulnerability that may allow an authenticated user to process and convert unintended document types if bypassing the Webmail experience.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Barracuda Networks Multiple Products OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG), Load Balancer, Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Message Archiver (BMA), WAF Control Center (WCC), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Web Security Gateway (WSG) contain an OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an authenticated administrator to inject OS commands that execute with root privileges when the crafted timezone value is subsequently processed. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-116606

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: IBM Aspera Faspex Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: IBM Aspera Faspex contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to craft a specific message to bypass authorization, causing privilege escalations.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: OpenBSD OpenSSH Unexpected Status Code or Return Value Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: OpenBSD OpenSSH on Linux contains an unexpected status code or return value vulnerability that could allow for authentication bypass.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SignalWire FreeSwitch Code Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: SignalWire FreeSwitch contains a code injection vulnerability that permits configuration and credential disclosure, arbitrary call control, and command execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: GPUStack Improper Authentication Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: GPUStack contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow unauthenticated administrative access, including user and model changes, persistent administrator API-key creation, disclosure of worker and cloud-provider secrets, and code execution through POST /v2/inference-backends/from-yaml.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Use of Single-factor Authentication Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN contains a use of single-factor authentication vulnerability that may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA).

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Improper Authentication Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS and watchOS 10.5 contain an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an attacker with arbitrary read and write capability to bypass pointer authentication.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: WordPress WordPress Core Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: WordPress WordPress Core contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server during the upgrade window. This is due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Generation of Predictable Numbers or Identifiers Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a generation of predictable numbers or identifiers vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Integer Overflow or Wraparound Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

vulnerabilities.product: Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software Unchecked Return Value to NULL Pointer Dereference Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software contains an unchecked return value to NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: PHP Stale Internal Request-State Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: PHP contains a stale internal request-state vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: PHP Memory Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server External Control of File Name or Path Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability which can allow an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Improper Neutralization of Encoded URI Schemes in a Web Page Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains an improper neutralization of encoded URI schemes in a web page vulnerability that could allow an attacker to call other plugins' functions and supply their own parameters. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Siemens Software Center Uncontrolled Search Path Element Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Email Gateway Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ahsay AhsayCBS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ahsay AhsayCBS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Code Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Strapi Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Strapi contains a cleartext storage of sensitive information vulnerability that could allow attackers with access to the admin panel to discover sensitive user details via the query filter. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-22621 to achieve remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Struts Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ISC BIND Data Processing Errors Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ProFTPD Improper Access Control Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiMail Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution or denial of service

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Code Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to leverage this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without any user interaction.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: WSO2 Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: F5 BIG-IP APM Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: F5 BIG-IP APM contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability when access policy and an OAuth profile are configured on a virtual server. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-prem contains an improper input validation vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, Multi-Domain Log Server, and SmartEvent contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Multiple Products Improper Certificate Validation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Check Point Security Gateway and Check Point Spark Firewall using Site to Site VPN or Remote Access VPN contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the Gateway.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Zyxel GS1900 series switches contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the CGI program which could allow a LAN-based, unauthenticated attacker to exploit the flaw and potentially execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ebtables SNAT target which allows an ARP sender hardware address rewrite to write directly into a nonlinear socket-buffer fragment backed by a splice-imported file page. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy and queuing assumptions. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Acronis Backup Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel & WHM and extension for Plesk contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Identity Services Engine Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Google Pixel Improper Authorization Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Google Pixel devices contain an improper authorization vulnerability in the cellular modem. A logic error may allow an attacker to bypass permission checks and escalate privileges.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Email Gateway SQL Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Cisco AsyncOS software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway (SEG) contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to read arbitrary files due to an improper path confinement and missing authentication enforcement in the repository commits API.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ConnectWise ScreenConnect Improper Privilege Management and Missing Authorization Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains both an improper privilege management and missing authorization vulnerability that may allow an attacker to transfer and execute files through an active remote session without authorization or host confirmation.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Improper Authentication Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could return an internal anonymous-user token to an unauthenticated caller when anonymous access is disabled, potentially exposing sensitive resources.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that leads to a privilege escalation attack due to a validation check of the token signature/issuer and not the token’s scope.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: MikroTik RouterOS Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacker to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: MikroTik RouterOS Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: MikroTik RouterOS contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows kernel memory disclosure and denial of service in the btest service.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Out of Bounds Write Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 contains an out of bounds write vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

vulnerabilities.product: Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Firewall Management Center Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management contain an authentication Bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and execute script files on an affected device to obtain root access to the underlying operating system.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an authentication-bypass vulnerability involving an alternate path or channel. When the NetScaler appliance is configured as an AAA virtual server or as a Gateway (SSL VPN, ICA Proxy, CVPN, or RDP Proxy), an unauthenticated remote threat actor may be able to bypass authentication.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet Multiple Products Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS, FortiSwitchManager, and FortiSASE contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specially crafted packets.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: N-able N-central Static Code Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: N-able N-central contains a static code injection vulnerability that could allow for pre-authentication remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to elevate privileges locally.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Link Following Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Update Stack contains a link following vulnerability that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges locally up to SYSTEM.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source contain an improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Sangoma Switchvox SQL Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sangoma Switchvox contains a SQL injection vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary SQL statements against the backend PostgreSQL database using a single crafted request, including database operations and remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could enable a remote authenticated attacker as administrator to execute arbitrary OS commands, resulting in remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to sensitive functionality and perform unauthorized operations.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Improper Authentication Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that under default configuration can allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to obtain administrative privileges.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: BerriAI LiteLLM Improper Authentication Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: BerriAI LiteLLM contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to establish an authenticated MCP session using an arbitrary Bearer token.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Kestra OSS OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Kestra OSS contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to create and execute arbitrary workflows without credentials.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Kludex Starlette HTTP Request/Response Smuggling Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Kludex Starlette contains a HTTP request/response smuggling vulnerability that could allow attackers to inject paths into the host part, prepending the actual path leading to issues such as authentication bypass when the authentication depends on the reconstructed URL’s path. This vulnerability could be chaned with CVE-2026-42271.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: PaperCut NG/MF Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: PaperCut NG/MF contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate system configuration parameters and execute arbitrary Java bytecode residing on the application classpath under the security context of the PaperCut server process. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-81578.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: PaperCut NG/MF Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: PaperCut NG/MF contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to modify certain system configurations. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-82078.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory vulnerability. This can allow an authenticated user to write data outside the intended Docker cache path under specific remote-repository conditions.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Unspecified Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an unspecified vulnerability that can allow for privilege escalation via IPv6 networking subsystem. This vulnerability can impact multiple products, including but not limited to Suse, Red Hat, and other products using Linux.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ownCloud Improper Authentication Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: ownCloud contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows an attacker to access, modify, or delete any file without authentication if the username of a victim is known, and the victim has no signing-key configured.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability which could lead to denial of service.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds memory write vulnerability which could allow a local user to gain privileged access or cause a denial of service on the system.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ajax.NET Professional Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ajax.NET Professional (AjaxPro) contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution via arbitrary .NET classes. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SQL Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft SQL Server contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute code in the context of the SQL Server Database Engine service account.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat Automatic Bug Reporting Tool Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Red Hat Automatic Bug Reporting Tool (ABRT) contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that could allow local users with certain permissions to gain privileges via a symlink attack on a file with a predictable name. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat Libuser Race Condition Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Red Hat libuser contains a race condition vulnerability that allows authenticated local users to corrupt the /etc/passwd file to cause a denial of service or privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Gitea Code Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Gitea contains a code injection vulnerability that allows an attacker with repository write access to send a malicious patch to the diffpatch API endpoint to plant an executable Git hook and run shell commands as the Gitea service account.

vulnerabilities.product: HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in Improper Access Control Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in contain an improper access control vulnerability that can result in unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to critical data as well as unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in accessible data.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to send specially crafted SMTP requests that may result in execution of arbitrary operating system commands as the Zimbra user.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TrueConf Server Code Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: TrueConf Server contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthorized remote attacker with network access via port 4307/TCP to use a specially crafted script to break out of the isolated environment and execute arbitrary code on the host system.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TrueConf Server Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: TrueConf Server contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow a remote unauthorized attacker with network access via port 4307/TCP to execute an arbitrary script.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: MLflow Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: MLflow contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that can allow attackers to reach internal or cloud metadata services and receive response_status and response_body.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apple macOS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apple macOS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker on the network to authenticate to Screen Sharing without valid credentials.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom VMware vCenter Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow a threat actor with network access to vCenter to execute arbitrary code.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Weak Authentication Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint contains a weak authentication vulnerability which allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions Double Free Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions contains a double free vulnerability that could enable remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ray-Project Ray Code Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ray-Project Ray contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow remote code execution. Developers using Ray as a development tool may be exposed to this vulnerability exploitable through Firefox and Safari.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Metabase SQL Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Metabase contains a SQL Injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to inject arbitrary SQL into the Metabase application database, which can give them administrator access to the instance. From there, the attacker could change the application configuration, steal stored credentials for the connected databases, read any data accessible through those connections, and export data.

vulnerabilities.product: Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock Use-After-Free Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

vulnerabilities.product: Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD)
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Heap Inspection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) contain a heap inspection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Progress LoadMaster Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Progress LoadMaster contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an un-authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the LoadMaster appliance by exploiting unsanitized input in multiple command endpoints.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: JetBrains TeamCity Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: JetBrains TeamCity contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated remote code execution via the agent polling protocol.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: IBM Langflow Code Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Langflow contains a code injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve full remote code execution on default Langflow deployments.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Tomcat Missing Encryption of Sensitive Data Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache Tomcat contains a missing encryption of sensitive data vulnerability that allows the bypass of the EncryptInterceptor. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE‑2025‑24813.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: N-able N-central Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: N-able N-central contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that allows for authentication bypass.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: N-able N-central Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: N-able N-central contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel allows for authentication bypass and account takeover in N-central. This vulnerability is the result of an incomplete patch for CVE-2026-18556.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center Use of Hard-coded Password Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) formerly known as Firepower Management Center contains a use of hard-coded password vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to log in to an affected device using a low-privileged account to access sensitive data within the impacted systems.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem contains an OS command injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS contains an exposure of sensitive information to an unauthorized actor vulnerability. This may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to bypass the patch developed for the symbolic link persistency mechanism observed in some post-exploit cases, via crafted HTTP requests. An attacker would need first to have compromised the product via another vulnerability, at filesystem level.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability which could allow an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Check Point SmartConsole Improper Authentication Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Check Point SmartConsole contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to obtain an application login token and use it to authenticate with full administrative privileges.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: WordPress Core Interpretation Conflict Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: WordPress Core contains an interpretation conflict vulnerability that could allow an attacker to perform SQL Injection and achieve Remote Code Execution. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-60137.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: WordPress Core SQL Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: WordPress Core contains a SQL injection vulnerability when a plugin or theme passes untrusted input to the parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-63030 to allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain remote code execution on default WordPress installations.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Langflow Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Langflow contains an inclusion of functionality from untrusted control sphere vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: DD-WRT Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: DD-WRT contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to overflow an internal buffer used by UPnP and trigger a code execution vulnerability.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiSandbox OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiSandbox contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via crafted HTTP requests.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiSandbox OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiSandbox, FortiSandbox Cloud, and FortiSandbox PaaS contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized commands via specifically crafted HTTP requests.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Oracle E-Business Suite Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Oracle E-Business Suite contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Payments. Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Payments.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: KNX Association KNX Protocol Connection Authorization Option 1 Overly Restrictive Account Lockout Mechanism Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: KNX Association KNX Protocol Connection Authorization Option 1 contains an overly restrictive account lockout mechanism vulnerability that could allow an attacker to purge all devices without additional security options enabled and set a BCU key to lock the device.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Server Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Active Directory Federation Services Insufficient Granularity of Access Control Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Active Directory Federation Services contains an insufficient granularity of access control vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Code Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contain a code injection vulnerability which in specific conditions could potentially enable a remote authenticated attacker as administrator to execute arbitrary OS commands.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contain a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to potentially cause the appliance to make requests to unintended location.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco IOS Cross-Site Request Forgery Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Cisco IOS 12.4 contains multiple cross-site forgery vulnerabilities that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands via (1) a certain "show privilege" command to the /level/15/exec/- URI, and (2) a certain "alias exec" command to the /level/15/exec/-/configure/http URI.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Balbooa Forms Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Balbooa Forms contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated arbitrary file upload which could allow uploading of executable files leading to full RCE.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: iCagenda Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: iCagenda contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows the upload of arbitrary files in the file attachment feature, ultimately resulting in PHP code upload and execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Joomlack Page Builder Improper Access Control Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Joomlack Page Builder contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution via unauthenticated arbitrary file upload.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Langflow Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Langflow contains an authorization bypass through user-controlled key vulnerability which allows an authenticated attacker to execute any flow belonging to another user by specifying the victim's flow ID in the request.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: JoomShaper SP Page Builder Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: JoomShaper SP Page Builder contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows unauthenticated users to upload arbitrary files, ultimately resulting in the upload and execution of PHP code.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Adobe ColdFusion Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Adobe ColdFusion contains a path traversal vulnerability that could lead to arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Server Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability which allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SimpleHelp Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: SimpleHelp contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the OIDC authentication flow. When OIDC authentication is configured, identity tokens submitted during login are accepted without verifying their cryptographic signature. In a vulnerable configuration, a remote, unauthenticated attacker can submit a forged token containing arbitrary identity claims to obtain a fully authenticated technician session. In some configurations, this may also allow bypass of multi-factor authentication.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Unified Communications Manager Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Cisco Unified Communications Manager (Unified CM) and Cisco Unified Communications Manager Session Management Edition (Unified CM SME) contain a server-side request forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write files to the underlying operating system that could be used later to elevate to root.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: PTC Windchill and FlexPLM Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: PTC Windchill and FlexPLM contains an improper input validation vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary code by sending a malicious request to the network.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ubiquiti UniFi OS Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains an improper input validation vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to conduct command injection.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ubiquiti UniFi OS Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to access files on the underlying system that could be manipulated to access an underlying account.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ubiquiti UniFi OS Improper Access Control Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains an improper access control vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to make unauthorized changes to the system.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Lantronix EDS5000 Code Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Lantronix EDS5000 contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow attackers to inject arbitrary OS commands into the username parameter. Injected commands are executed with root privileges.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Splunk Enterprise Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Splunk Enterprise contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated user to create or truncate arbitrary files through a PostgreSQL sidecar service endpoint.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Widget Factory Joomla Content Editor Improper Access Control Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Widget Factory Joomla Content Editor contains an improper access control vulnerability which could allow for upload and execution of PHP code via the creation of new editor profiles for unauthenticated users.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin UNIX Symbolic Link (Symlink) Following Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: LiteSpeed cPanel plugin contains a UNIX symbolic link (Symlink) following vulnerability that could allow a user with FTP or web shell access on a shared hosting server running CloudLinux/CageFS.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Directory or Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a directory or path traversal vulnerability that could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to create a file or overwrite any file on the filesystem of an affected system.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Oracle PeopleSoft Enterprise PeopleTools Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Oracle PeopleSoft Enterprise PeopleTools contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to obtain takeover of PeopleSoft Enterprise PeopleTools.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Sentry OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ivanti Sentry (formerly known as MobileIron Sentry) contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could allow a remote unauthenticated user to achieve root-level remote code execution. This vulnerability can be successfully exploited in cases where the Sentry appliance is in an unmanaged state with its endpoints externally reachable. The use of mTLS with EPMM or restricted HTTPS access through Neurons for MDM makes interfaces inaccessible to external actors.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Arista Extensible Operating System Incomplete Comparison with Missing Factors Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Arista Extensible Operating System (EOS) contains an incomplete comparison with missing factors vulnerability when the switch incorrectly decapsulate and forwards other unexpected tunneled packet with a destination IP matching its configured decapsulation IP.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager formerly SD-WAN vManage contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an authenticated, local attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root by supplying a crafted file to the affected system.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Out-of-Bounds Read and Write Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside a sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Security Gateway Improper Authentication Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Check Point Security Gateway contains an improper authentication vulnerability in IKEv1 key exchange that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass user authentication and establish a remote access VPN connection without a valid user password.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: BerriAI LiteLLM Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: BerriAI LiteLLM contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow any authenticated user, including holders of low-privilege internal-user keys, to run arbitrary commands on the host.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SolarWinds Serv-U Uncontrolled Resource Consumption Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: SolarWinds Serv-U contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows specially crafted POST requests using the Content-Encoding: deflate header to crash the Serv-U service without authentication.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Mirasvit Full Page Cache Warmer Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Mirasvit Full Page Cache Warmer contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by supplying a crafted serialized PHP object in the CacheWarmer cookie.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Android Framework Integer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Android Framework contains an integer overflow vulnerability that allows for code execution that could allow for local privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Improper Authentication Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow for privilege escalation via the cgroups v1 release_agent feature.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Oracle WebLogic Server Unspecified Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Oracle WebLogic contains an unspecified vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access via T3, IIOP to compromise Oracle WebLogic Server. Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle WebLogic Server accessible data.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass security restrictions and establish an unauthorized VPN connection.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Daemon Tools Lite Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Daemon Tools contains an unspecified vulnerability that has a high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Nx Console Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Nx Console contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability that allowed a malicious version of Nx Console to be published. The compromised extension fetched an obfuscated payload that could harvested credentials from multiple sources on disk and in memory.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: TanStack Unspecified Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: TanStack contains an unspecified vulnerability that allowed malicious versions of the product to be published to the npm registry to publish credential-stealing malware under a trusted identity.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin contains privilege escalation vulnerability that is exposed via the user-end cPanel plugin, which can be abused by any cPanel user account to execute arbitrary scripts with root privileges.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Drupal Core SQL Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Drupal Core contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation and remote code execution via specially crafted requests sent with the database abstraction API.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Trend Micro Apex One (On-Premise) Directory Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Trend Micro Apex One (on-premise) contains a directory traversal vulnerability that could allow a pre-authenticated local attacker to modify a key table on the server to inject malicious code to deploy to agents on affected installations.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Langflow Origin Validation Error Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Langflow contains an origin validation error vulnerability in which an overly permissive CORS configuration combined with a refresh token cookie configured as SameSite=None allows a malicious webpage to perform cross-origin requests that include credentials and successfully call the refresh endpoint. This could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary code and achieve full system compromise via obtained tokens that permit access to authenticated endpoints.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Defender Denial of Service Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Defender contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for denial of service.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Defender Link Following Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Defender contains a link following vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Explorer Use-After-Free Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains an use-after-free vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via vectors involving access to an invalid pointer after the deletion of an object. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Explorer Use-After-Free Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains an use-after-free vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code by accessing a pointer associated with a deleted object. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Acrobat and Reader Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Adobe Acrobat and Reader contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability which could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted PDF file that triggers memory corruption.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft DirectX NULL Byte Overwrite Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft DirectX contains a NULL byte overwrite vulnerability in the QuickTime Movie Parser Filter in quartz.dll in DirectShow which could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted QuickTime media file.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in the Windows Server Service that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted RPC request that triggers an overflow during path canonicalization.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability during web page generation in Outlook Web Access and when certain interaction conditions are met, arbitrary JavaScript can be executed in the browser context.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller & Manager contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and obtain administrative privileges on an affected system.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: BerriAI LiteLLM SQL Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: BerriAI LiteLLM contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to read data from the proxy's database and potentially modify it, leading to unauthorized access to the proxy and the credentials it manages.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows a remotely authenticated user with administrative access to achieve remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Out-of-bounds Write Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the User-ID Authentication Portal (aka Captive Portal) service that can allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the PA-Series and VM-Series firewalls by sending specially crafted packets.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Incorrect Resource Transfer Between Spheres Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an incorrect resource transfer between spheres vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: WebPros cPanel & WHM and WP2 (WordPress Squared) Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: WebPros cPanel & WHM (WebHost Manager) and WP2 (WordPress Squared) contain an authentication bypass vulnerability in the login flow that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to gain unauthorized access to the control panel.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Protection Mechanism Failure Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a protection mechanism failure vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ConnectWise ScreenConnect Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow an attacker to execute remote code or directly impact confidential data and critical systems.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DIR-823X Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: D-Link DIR-823X contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to execute arbitrary commands on remote devices by sending a POST request to /goform/set_prohibiting via the corresponding function. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Samsung MagicINFO 9 Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
